bio: I'm Hendra Agil — a frontend-focused software engineer with a full-stack mindset and a passion for crafting digital experiences that truly solve problems. Over the past 4+ years, I've taken on founding engineer, product ownership, and team leadership roles across startups, companies, and communities, helping build platforms used by thousands of users. description: 👋 Hello! My name is Hendra Agil Syaputra, usually called Hendra / Agil. Born and raised in Karanganyar Regency, Central Java, Indonesia. Graduated from SMKN 2 Karanganyar in 2021 as a Software Engineering student, and currently studying at Binus Online Learning.

I'm a frontend-focused software engineer with a full-stack mindset — passionate about crafting digital experiences that actually solve problems. My journey started back in 2019 when I first picked up PHP in school, and since then I've gone deeper into JavaScript, Node.js, and React. Over the past 4+ years, I've taken on founding engineer, product ownership, and team leadership roles across companies and communities, building platforms used by thousands of users.

Outside of building things, I'm always exploring what's next in the web ecosystem, whether it's accessibility, testing, CI/CD, or AI-powered features. I enjoy the process of turning ideas into intuitive, reliable products just as much as connecting with people who share the same curiosity.
